dataset.title: Electricity net imports (EIA, derived)

indicator.name: Electricity net imports (imports − exports)
indicator.description: EIA electricity imports minus exports for the same country and year, in BKWH (billion kilowatt-hours). Positive = net importer, negative = net exporter.

source.name: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), International Energy Statistics
source.license: Public domain (U.S. Government data); EIA asks to be credited as the source
source.citation: Derived from U.S. EIA International Energy Statistics exports "electricity-imports-SeriesExport-10-12-2026-18-32-26.json" and "electricity-exports-SeriesExport-10-12-2026-18-32-54.json".

notes: Computed by npm run data:import from eia-electricity-imports and eia-electricity-exports: for each entity, the latest year in which both have a number. Entities with no such year are kept as missing.
Both inputs state the same unit (BKWH); the importer refuses to combine series with different units.
caveats: Absolute volume in source units: not adjusted for consumption, population or economy size, so large economies dominate. It shows the net trade balance, not a dependence share.

scoring.rationale: Net trade volume in absolute units; without consumption of the same fuel it is not a dependence share, so it is context only.
